rss_bridge_cache_custom_timeout.description: Allow users to specify custom timeout for specific requests.

rss_bridge_proxy_url.description: Sets the proxy url (i.e. "tcp://192.168.0.0:32"). Empty string means proxy disabled.

rss_bridge_proxy_name.description: Sets the proxy name that is shown on the bridge instead of the proxy url.

rss_bridge_proxy_by_bridge.description: Allow users to disable proxy usage for specific requests.

rss_bridge_auth_enable.description: Enables authentication for all requests to this RSS-Bridge instance.

rss_bridge_auth_username.description: The username for authentication. Insert this name when prompted for login.

rss_bridge_auth_password.description: The password for authentication. Insert this password when prompted for login.
